items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: He was sitting at the meet and he said, you can't use that name.

ctx.x: The cheeky guy is supposed to be a nervy guy, you know. Cheeky. Let me your automobile, I want to go up to Baton Rouge. That's after you were married in 1938. Yeah, that was after around 1938. Well they had a real fine ball player named Bull Raw. I used to pitch for the Pelicans. He was sitting at the meet and he said, you can't use that name. I said, what's going to stop me? A little cheeky man. I think we were sabotaged.
Who made the sweatshirts for you?
